dialogues.jp: 特筆すべき事件も無いまま、卒業式は終わった。
dialogues.en: The graduation ceremony took place with no major incident.
dialogues.text: The graduation ceremony took place with no major incident.

dialogues.jp:
俺は暖かい春の風が吹き抜ける校舎を｛すがすが／清々｝しい
気持ちでぶらついていた。
dialogues.en:
The refreshing, warm spring wind felt great as it blew past
me.
dialogues.text:
The refreshing, warm spring wind felt great as it blew past
me.

dialogues.jp:
手には卒業証書の入った筒――何故にこの手の
「格式ある」証書入れには気色の悪い鱗模様が
入っているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
In my hand was my diploma wrapped up in a tube--with a
rather strange fish scale-like pattern on it.
dialogues.text:
In my hand was my diploma wrapped up in a tube--with a
rather strange fish scale-like pattern on it.

dialogues.jp:
――何か俺のしらない、宇宙科学にもとづいた
法則でもあるのか……。
dialogues.en:
--Maybe this school is into more occult things than I
realized...
dialogues.text:
--Maybe this school is into more occult things than I
realized...

dialogues.jp: 「ま、どうでもいいけどな」
dialogues.en: "Well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "Well, whatever."

dialogues.jp:
大きく｛あくび／欠伸｝を漏らし、伸びをする。心地好い｛けん／倦｝
｛たい／怠｝。
dialogues.en: I yawned and stretched, pleasantly bored.
dialogues.text: I yawned and stretched, pleasantly bored.

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず大きな義務的イベントは片付いたの
だ。
dialogues.en:
I might as well enjoy it while I can; there's a compulsory
event coming up anyway.
dialogues.text:
I might as well enjoy it while I can; there's a compulsory
event coming up anyway.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……あとは卒パを堪能するのみだな」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'd see how the graduation party is going."
dialogues.text: "I guess I'd see how the graduation party is going."

dialogues.jp:
旨げな匂いを立ち昇らせている屋台を物色しつ
つ校内をふらつく。
dialogues.en:
I stood up and started exploring the various food carts and
stores around,
dialogues.text:
I stood up and started exploring the various food carts and
stores around,

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺の目に、喧騒に取り残されるようにひ
とり｛たたず／佇｝む工藤の姿が留まった。
dialogues.en: Kudou was standing some ways away, deep in thought.
dialogues.text: Kudou was standing some ways away, deep in thought.

dialogues.jp: 「よ、工藤」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Kudou."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Kudou."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、軽く手を挙げて声を掛ける。
dialogues.en: I called out to him, waving my hand.
dialogues.text: I called out to him, waving my hand.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、朝倉か」
dialogues.en: "Ah, it's you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah, it's you, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
開いた窓から吹く風に工藤の前髪が揺れる。あ
いかわらず、男の風上にも置けないような見事
なサラサラヘアー。
dialogues.en:
A gust of wind blew past the open window, setting Kudou's
hair asway. It had an amazing sheen as it shook.
dialogues.text:
A gust of wind blew past the open window, setting Kudou's
hair asway. It had an amazing sheen as it shook.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？　神妙な顔して」
dialogues.en: "What's up? You look pretty thoughtful."
dialogues.text: "What's up? You look pretty thoughtful."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「いや………………三年間、よく頑張って来ら
　れたなって………………」
dialogues.en:
"Not really...... just thinking about how hard we all worked
to get past these three years."
dialogues.text:
"Not really...... just thinking about how hard we all worked
to get past these three years."

dialogues.jp: 感慨深げにつぶやく工藤。
dialogues.en: His deep feelings on the subject were plain to see.
dialogues.text: His deep feelings on the subject were plain to see.

dialogues.jp:
なんだか「これから社会に巣立っていく若者」
チックな物言い……大袈裟な奴だな。
dialogues.en:
He's talking as if he's some baby bird getting ready to
leave the nest... what a dreamy fellow.
dialogues.text:
He's talking as if he's some baby bird getting ready to
leave the nest... what a dreamy fellow.

dialogues.jp:
「なーに感傷に浸ってんだよ。これから三年、
　また同じ学園に通うんだろーが？」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, I can see your emotion dripping onto the floor. We'd
still be in the same school for the next three years, no?"
dialogues.text:
"Geez, I can see your emotion dripping onto the floor. We'd
still be in the same school for the next three years, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃそうだけどさ……たく、お前って奴は」
dialogues.en: "That's true, but.... bah, idiot."
dialogues.text: "That's true, but.... bah, idiot."

dialogues.jp:
ムードのないことを言うな、という瞳で俺を｛にら／睨｝
む工藤。別にいいじゃないか、事実なんだから。
dialogues.en:
Kudou glanced at me with slight displeasure. It's true,
though...
dialogues.text:
Kudou glanced at me with slight displeasure. It's true,
though...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ところで、アレはどうした」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, is that ready?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, is that ready?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「アレとは？」
dialogues.en: "That?"
dialogues.text: "That?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「とぼけんな、第２ボタンだよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't act dumb, I meant the second button."
dialogues.text: "Don't act dumb, I meant the second button."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだったな」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, THAT."
dialogues.text: "Ohh, THAT."

dialogues.jp: そういえばそんな約束をしてたっけ。
dialogues.en: Now that he said it, I did promise that a few days ago.
dialogues.text: Now that he said it, I did promise that a few days ago.

dialogues.jp:
けしてとぼけてた訳ではないぞ、本気で忘れて
いたのだ。
dialogues.en: I wasn't acting dumb, I'd really completely forgotten.
dialogues.text: I wasn't acting dumb, I'd really completely forgotten.

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待ってろ……」
dialogues.en: "Wait a sec..."
dialogues.text: "Wait a sec..."

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅうううぅぅ、と力をこめて、ボタンを引っ
張る。
dialogues.en:
I put all my strength into tearing the button off my
uniform.
dialogues.text:
I put all my strength into tearing the button off my
uniform.

dialogues.jp:
が、ボタンはかなりがっちりと縫い付けられて
いるらしく簡単には外れてくれなかった。
dialogues.en:
But it was made well. The button still held tight
stubbornly.
dialogues.text:
But it was made well. The button still held tight
stubbornly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「何やってんだよ、服に穴空いちまうだろ」
dialogues.en: "You're going to put a hole in your uniform like that."
dialogues.text: "You're going to put a hole in your uniform like that."

dialogues.jp: 工藤は｛とが／咎｝めるように俺の袖をひいた。
dialogues.en: Kudou started nagging at me for some reason.
dialogues.text: Kudou started nagging at me for some reason.

dialogues.jp:
「いいだろ、別に。どうせ新学期になったら一
　新するんだし」
dialogues.en:
"It's fine. We'd have new uniforms for the new school year
anyway."
dialogues.text:
"It's fine. We'd have new uniforms for the new school year
anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そういう問題じゃねえの。物は大事にしろよ」
dialogues.en: "That's not the problem! It's a precious thing, you know."
dialogues.text: "That's not the problem! It's a precious thing, you know."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……意外と説教臭いのな、お前」
dialogues.en: "...That's unexpected coming from you."
dialogues.text: "...That's unexpected coming from you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ほっといてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Just stay quiet."
dialogues.text: "Just stay quiet."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はポケットの中から小さなハサミを出し、
俺の胸元にあてがった。
dialogues.en:
Kudou took a familiar-looking pair of scissors from his
chest pocket, and brought it to my uniform.
dialogues.text:
Kudou took a familiar-looking pair of scissors from his
chest pocket, and brought it to my uniform.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「糸切るから、動くなよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm going to cut it, don't move."
dialogues.text: "I'm going to cut it, don't move."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「お、おぅ」
dialogues.en: "O, okay."
dialogues.text: "O, okay."

dialogues.jp:
目の前の工藤の頭からは、芳しいシトラスの香
りが漂っている。俺はなんだか不思議な気分に
なりつつその香りを嗅いでいた。
dialogues.en:
With the top of Kudou's head in front of me, I could smell a
fragrant citrus scent, giving me a weird feeling...
dialogues.text:
With the top of Kudou's head in front of me, I could smell a
fragrant citrus scent, giving me a weird feeling...

dialogues.jp:
ぷちっ、と軽く引っ張られる感触と同時に工藤
が頭をあげる。
dialogues.en:
At the same time I felt something being cut away from my
uniform, Kudou's head retracted itself from it's proximity
to my chest.
dialogues.text:
At the same time I felt something being cut away from my
uniform, Kudou's head retracted itself from it's proximity
to my chest.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「はい、よし。じゃあ貰ってくよ」
dialogues.en: "Done. I'd go give it to her now."
dialogues.text: "Done. I'd go give it to her now."

dialogues.jp:
その手には年季がかって黒ずんだ俺の第２ボタ
ンが握られていた。
dialogues.en: The second button of my uniform was safely snug in his hand.
dialogues.text: The second button of my uniform was safely snug in his hand.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、工藤！」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Kudou!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Kudou!"

dialogues.jp:
そのままさっさと行こうとする背中に慌てて呼
びかける。
dialogues.en: I shouted out hurriedly at Kudou's fast-moving back.
dialogues.text: I shouted out hurriedly at Kudou's fast-moving back.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: 工藤が振り向いた。
dialogues.en: He turned around to face me again.
dialogues.text: He turned around to face me again.

dialogues.jp:
「ボタン、渡しに行くんだろ？　俺も一緒に行っ
　ていいか？」
dialogues.en: "You're going to hand over the button, right? Can I go too?"
dialogues.text: "You're going to hand over the button, right? Can I go too?"

dialogues.jp:
俺に想いを寄せてくれているという、女の子を
是非とも一度見てみたい。
dialogues.en:
Getting my thoughts together quickly, I knew that at the
very least, I wanted to see this girl once.
dialogues.text:
Getting my thoughts together quickly, I knew that at the
very least, I wanted to see this girl once.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「え！？　いや駄目だ、それは出来ない！」
dialogues.en: "Eh!? No, you can't!"
dialogues.text: "Eh!? No, you can't!"

dialogues.jp:
何故だか工藤は慌てた様子で首をぶんぶんと振っ
た。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's reaction was surprisingly quick, shaking his head
back and forth vigourously.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's reaction was surprisingly quick, shaking his head
back and forth vigourously.

dialogues.jp: 「なんでだよ？　会わせてくれたっていいだろ」
dialogues.en: "Why not? It'd be good to meet her."
dialogues.text: "Why not? It'd be good to meet her."

dialogues.jp: その態度に、口を尖らす俺。
dialogues.en: My lips turned into a small pout.
dialogues.text: My lips turned into a small pout.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「駄目なもんは駄目なんだよ！」
dialogues.en: "No means no!"
dialogues.text: "No means no!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「………さては和装の似合う女の子というのは
　嘘八百で、宇宙生物ゴルゴンゾーラって感じ
　の怪人めいた相手なんだな！」
dialogues.en:
"...I bet you were lying about the kimono-wearing girl,
weren't you? It's some gorgonzola space creature, isn't it!"
dialogues.text:
"...I bet you were lying about the kimono-wearing girl,
weren't you? It's some gorgonzola space creature, isn't it!"

dialogues.jp:
強い口調できめつけてやると工藤は顔を真っ赤
にして返した。
dialogues.en: My aggresive tone made his face turned bright red.
dialogues.text: My aggresive tone made his face turned bright red.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「失礼だな！　そんな事ねーよ！！」
dialogues.en: "Watch your mouth! That's not true!"
dialogues.text: "Watch your mouth! That's not true!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だったら会わせろよ」
dialogues.en: "Then let me meet her."
dialogues.text: "Then let me meet her."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「う、いや、あの……彼女、すげー内気だから
　きっと朝倉本人に会ったら恥ずかしがって隠
　れちまうよ」
dialogues.en:
"Uh, but, that's... she's the really shy type, so if she
actually met you in person, she'd get embarassed and run
away!"
dialogues.text:
"Uh, but, that's... she's the really shy type, so if she
actually met you in person, she'd get embarassed and run
away!"

dialogues.jp:
もごもごと歯切れの悪い工藤。なんなのだその
態度は……ますます怪しいこと、この上ないぞ。
dialogues.en:
He was gnashing his teeth as he explained... what's with the
suspicious behaviour?
dialogues.text:
He was gnashing his teeth as he explained... what's with the
suspicious behaviour?

dialogues.jp: 「いや、でも一目くらい」
dialogues.en: "But I just wanted one look."
dialogues.text: "But I just wanted one look."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……と、とにかく！　彼女には会わせられな
　いの！」
dialogues.en: "...I, in any case! I can't let you meet her!"
dialogues.text: "...I, in any case! I can't let you meet her!"

dialogues.jp: ぱこん！
dialogues.en: *bang!*
dialogues.text: *bang!*

dialogues.jp: 「って！」
dialogues.en: "Gwah!"
dialogues.text: "Gwah!"

dialogues.jp:
工藤は卒業証書の筒で俺に一発食らわせると、
そのまま走り去ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Kudou threw his graduation certificate tube at me as a
distraction, then quickly ran off.
dialogues.text:
Kudou threw his graduation certificate tube at me as a
distraction, then quickly ran off.

dialogues.jp: 「畜生、逃げられたか………」
dialogues.en: "Damnit, he escaped..."
dialogues.text: "Damnit, he escaped..."

dialogues.jp:
ああまで隠されると逆に気になるのが人のサガ
というもの。
dialogues.en:
Searching for this girl would be like trying to find a
needle in a haystack as well.
dialogues.text:
Searching for this girl would be like trying to find a
needle in a haystack as well.

dialogues.jp: ……まぁ、宇宙生物だという事はないにしても。
dialogues.en: ...Well, he said it wasn't some space monster at least.
dialogues.text: ...Well, he said it wasn't some space monster at least.

dialogues.jp:
まさか工藤、引っ込み思案な彼女に恩を着せて、
上手いこと自分がいただく気ではあるまいな。
dialogues.en:
I bet he was made to promise by that girl not to let me see
her, and tried to put it on himself...
dialogues.text:
I bet he was made to promise by that girl not to let me see
her, and tried to put it on himself...

dialogues.jp: （俺の『｛やまとなでしこ／彼女｝』を独り占めしようなどと……）
dialogues.en: "(I really do have my very own yamato nadesico...)"
dialogues.text: "(I really do have my very own yamato nadesico...)"

dialogues.jp:
――と、付き合うどころか顔さえ見たことのな
い女の子に対して独占欲を募らせる。
dialogues.en:
--But it's not really realistic to say that when I haven't
even seen her face.
dialogues.text:
--But it's not really realistic to say that when I haven't
even seen her face.

dialogues.jp:
そんなこんなで『まだ見ぬ彼女』への興味はま
すます大きくなっていくのだった。
dialogues.en: Thus, my interest in the Yet-To-Be-Seen Girl grew even more.
dialogues.text: Thus, my interest in the Yet-To-Be-Seen Girl grew even more.

dialogues.jp: ◆未だ見ぬ彼女◆
dialogues.en: ◆Yet-To-Be-Seen Girl◆
dialogues.text: ◆Yet-To-Be-Seen Girl◆

dialogues.jp:
卒パの屋台を冷やかしつつ、校内をふらついて
いると、工藤が居た。
dialogues.en:
While wandering about the food stores at the graduation
party, I bumped into Kudou.
dialogues.text:
While wandering about the food stores at the graduation
party, I bumped into Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
取りあえず、約束していたボタンを工藤に渡し
たが、俺のボタンを受け取る女の子の事を尋ね
ると、はぐらかされ、逃げられてしまう。
dialogues.en:
After relieving me of my uniform's second button, I asked
about my secret admirer, but he ran away.
dialogues.text:
After relieving me of my uniform's second button, I asked
about my secret admirer, but he ran away.

dialogues.jp: ううっ、激しくどんな子なのか気になるぞ！
dialogues.en: Grr, I just want to see her face!
dialogues.text: Grr, I just want to see her face!
